note: Recurring cast (spec §5, OPEN_QUESTIONS #3, #5). Names and biographies are placeholders for the owner to replace. 'friend' and 'parent' are resolved per campaign. Ids of players are the ids used on the field. `roles` name the teammates the story arc leans on (striker, organiser, keeper, newcomer): arc content addresses them by role so shared scenes read the same in both campaigns while still pointing at real roster identities.

shared.name: Coach Code
shared.bio: Strict, loud, passionate, demanding, detail-oriented and compassionate; funny; listens; admits mistakes; no grudges when players leave.

shared.name: Coach Delgado
shared.bio: Sonoran United U12 head coach and the club's recruiter. Polished, persuasive, promises more than the roster can hold.

shared.name: Coach Whitfield
shared.bio: Camelback Athletic technical director. Former winger; judges everyone by their first touch and means it kindly.

shared.name: Coach Nakamura
shared.bio: Mesa Verde SC U12 coach. Calm, asks about school before soccer, keeps every promise small enough to keep.

shared.name: Coach Bell
shared.bio: Saguaro Rangers coach and PE teacher. Plays everyone, travels nowhere, promises nothing.

shared.name: Coach Okafor
shared.bio: Red Rock FC academy coach, ex-professional goalkeeper. Blunt about evidence; warm once you have some.
